name: Onshore wind
applications: supplying electrolysers and electrified oil and gas sites
principle: Horizontal-axis turbines on land convert wind to electricity through a rotor, gearbox or direct-drive generator and a power converter. The IEA Clean Energy Technology Guide rates onshore wind TRL 9. The DOE market report page was not reachable, so figures on turbine size and cost are not yet on this card.

source.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Onshore wind' 9 (2025)

sources.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, TRL for onshore wind
